title: No-Bake Cheesecake Pecan Pie
creator: Justine Kameron
prepTime: Not specified (about 10 minutes of stovetop work in the video)
cookTime: Topping cooked on the stovetop until it boils, then a minute or two more with the pecans; chill 1-2 hours (she says it needed about 3)
ingredients: 3/4 cup light brown sugar (she eyeballs it)
Ground cinnamon, as much or as little as you like
1 tub Philadelphia No Bake Cheesecake Filling, Original (tub size not stated)
instructions: Step 1: Melt the stick of butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Step 2: Add 3/4 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream, cinnamon to taste, and a little salt.
Step 3: Whisk until the butter is melted, the sugar is dissolved, and the cream is incorporated, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Step 4: Once it bubbles and boils, turn the heat down to medium-low.
Step 5: Stir in 1 3/4 cups pecan halves and let it sit on the heat for a minute or two so the pecans toast a little.
Step 6: Take the pan off the heat and set it aside to cool briefly.
Step 7: Turn the tub of no-bake cheesecake filling out into the 10-inch graham cracker crust and spread it edge to edge.
Step 8: Pour the pecan mixture over the cheesecake layer and spread it edge to edge with a clean spatula.
Step 9: Cover with the crust's plastic lid and chill in the fridge for 1-2 hours (after 2 hours hers was still a little soft; she said it needed one more hour).
Step 10: Top with dollops of Reddi-wip, slice, and serve.
notes: From a Justine Kameron Facebook reel captioned 'Easy Fall Time Dessert... I make a cheesecake pecan pie.' The caption has no recipe and she answered none of the recipe questions in the comments; amounts come from her spoken narration. Not stated: the size of the cheesecake filling tub, the amount of cinnamon and salt, and exactly how long the topping cooled before pouring (she says 'a second'; a commenter asked the same). Alternatives she mentions: a homemade no-bake filling of cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla, a baked cheesecake, or a homemade crust. Commenter tips (not from the creator): pre-bake the crust with a few pats of butter for 10-15 minutes at 350°F and cool before filling; a gluten-free graham crust works; one asked about adding pumpkin to the topping. Chill longer than 2 hours, ideally about 3, so it slices cleanly.
